project.title: Changes in Activated Sludge Microbial Community structure in response to oxygen perturbation
project.description: Dissolved oxygen concentration was systematically increased in a lab-scale reactor seeded with activated sludge from the tropics with the goal of achieving nitritation or the washout of nitrite oxidising bacteria while maintaining the activity of ammonia oxidising bacteria.
